meaning: Pending one original KernelParity four-column RK4 FP64 witness on clean e0 source; unchanged seven accepted-scene and two negative packets, independent scalar-neighbour comparisons, numerical assertions and nine actual-sample1000ms submission limits. Original OpenProbe first loads parity_probe.spv and then the coupled FP64 module; unsupported decline is not positive evidence. Existing1GiB device-buffer limit is distinct from prospective300s external diagnostic/aggregate4GiB host RSS/reserve2GiB. No registered whole-test TIMEOUT is asserted. Default cache and LVP device0 follow mature apparatus; any external focused LVP_JIT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=0 must be explicitly recorded by root and confers no original cold authority. Runtime materialization/admission is held until current native7 terminal PASS, independent/root review and root scheduling decision. No40field/fullP1/E2/science/Mandatory/release/performance claim.
